rationale: The plan correctly uses ~batch+condition with an explicit control reference level, DESeq2 internal size-factor normalization with no pre-adjustment of counts, and Wald test with apeglm shrinkage and BH at alpha 0.05, matching the reference exactly. QC precedes testing with blind-VST PCA and distance heatmap colored by both condition and batch, plus library size and outlier flagging. The low-count filter is minimal and justified by group size, though the >=10-in-6-samples threshold is slightly more explicit/strict than a bare 'minimal' rule, a very small deduction. Enrichment was not explicitly requested but is reasonably included and done well (full ranked list, stated ranking metric, named collections, size window, universe), though the reference implies enrichment may not be warranted, so this adds unrequested scope without harming correctness. Report is thorough, naming method, versions, design, thresholds, counts, and caveats.
